name: locale-prefs-disabled-locale-no-wipe-modern-debug
description: Issue #18 sprint 4: a real ExpansionUserPrefs record whose stored localeId (qps-ploc, 7) IS a supported slot but is not enabled by THIS build's own compiled-in mask is classified EXPANSION_USER_PREFS_DISABLED_LOCALE by the real ExpansionUserPrefs_ValidateRaw()/Normalize() pair, requiring a re-prompt (here AUTO_SELECT collapses it, since the default build only enables one locale). Proves the re-prompt/auto-correct path never wipes SRAM: both checkpoints hash the WHOLE 0x8000 image excluding (a) the 12-byte ExpansionUserPrefs sub-record itself (offset 0x73D4 -- the only bytes this path is allowed to rewrite) and (b) the vanilla SoundRoomSaveData struct (include/bmsave.h, offset 0x7224, size 0x24) -- a pre-existing, locale-unrelated struct that ordinary vanilla boot-time bookkeeping legitimately rewrites on every boot regardless of prefs state, confirmed via a full-0x8000-byte diff sweep during this sprint (see reports/issue18_localization_closure.md). An equal sram_hash at both checkpoints -- captured for real, not hand-written -- is empirical proof that InitGlobalSaveInfodata()'s full-SRAM wipe path was never taken.
